instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the pocket cuts from the supplied sketches. Use Sketch003 to create the first pocket with a depth of 2 mm. Mirror the 5 mm pad feature and this 2 mm pocket together across Sketch001 as shown. Then use Sketch004 to create the second pocket with a depth of 5 mm, cutting in the reversed direction as shown. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
